response.sql: WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM manager_counts ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, manager_id LIMIT 10;
